{{Quote|Enclosed is my revised manuscript of the ''Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy'', with changes as specified by Lieutenant Pandur. The lieutenant's suggestions greatly assisted me in my research processes, and I sincerely hope that you will find the expanded information to be of value.|Obo Rin, in a message to Major Vontenn, Imperial Liaison Officer of Sentientology Studies|<ref name="GG4-2" />}}
The '''Imperial Liaison Officer of Sentientology Studies''' was a [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] position of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was held by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Vontenn]]. While the [[Imperial Liaison|officer]] was holding the position, the [[sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]], whom the Empire had commissioned to [[Author/Legends|author]] a reference work&mdash;the ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]''&mdash;detailing the various [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], sent them a message. In it, Obo Rin included their manuscript of a revised edition of the work, and in<ref name="GG4-2" /> his<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> missive, the researcher expressed his hope that Vontenn would find the expanded work useful. In the message, Obo Rin also asked the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] to pass on his condolences to the family of Major [[Herrit]],<ref name="GG4-2" /> an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]]<ref name="GG4" /> who had [[Death/Legends|perished]] on a mission<ref name="GG4-2" /> aimed to further benefit Obo Rin's research.<ref name="GG4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The position of Imperial Liaison Officer of Sentientology Studies was mentioned in [[Chuck Truett]]'s [[1994]] [[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|Second Edition]] of<ref name="GG4-2" /> ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook authored by [[Troy Denning]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG4" />
